provenance.description: 独自カタログ仕様に基づくAI生成。通常版とpixel版を別途生成。

expanded_prompts.sm-decay-019-default-attempt001-prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original creature portrait sprite for a 2D creature-raising game
Primary request: Create exactly one full-body creature following the complete independent brief below. This is a new design; do not base it on any existing character.
Management only, do not render text: sm-decay-019 / ヒラダネム / 腐体 (decay)
Body and exact anatomy: 体幹1節の縦に短い樹皮板形。脚9本、目2個、翼0枚、尾2本。片側に半円の棚が3段張り出す
Materials and biological motif: 枯木表面の柔らかな棚状菌。乾いた樹皮の細片を受け、雨で少しずつ土へ流す
Primary, secondary, accent colors respectively: #B69069; #8D8A95; #E9D5B6
Three mandatory visual identifiers: 三段の棚は下段ほど幅広い; 九本脚は下辺から三本ずつのまとまりで出る; 二本尾は棚のない側へ水平に伸びる
Pose: 棚の張り出しを斜め前から見せ、脚を短く曲げる
Temperament to convey through expression or posture: 安定志向。斜面でも棚を水平に保つ. If the brief specifies zero eyes or no face, do not invent eyes or facial features; express temperament through posture only.
Style: cohesive hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration, clear dark colored contour, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, appealing natural creature proportions, clean readable form.
Composition: isolated single creature, full body; by default use a slight top-down three-quarter view facing toward image-right. If the individual pose explicitly requires a front or top view, that explicit pose takes priority. Preserve the specified pose and physical left/right features. Centered in a square canvas, no cropping. Keep transparent padding on all sides. Intended final canvas is 1024 by 1024 pixels, with the longest creature extent about 768–896 pixels and at least 64 pixels of clear padding.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no diffuse glow. Habitat, rocks, water surfaces and action scenery mentioned in the brief describe only body posture or temperament; do not render those objects or environments.
Constraints: preserve exact anatomy, all three identifiers and the position of the palette colors; no costume or held tool unless explicitly part of the brief.
Individual forbidden changes: 棚を翼として左右対称にしない; 樹皮板を人型の胴にしない; 脚を骨や鋭い爪に変えない
Avoid: extra creatures, humans, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, gradients bleeding into the transparent area, photorealism, 3D render, imitation of an existing character.
expanded_prompts.sm-decay-019-default-attempt002-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit this exact original creature, preserve identity and the three asymmetrical shelf structures. Correct the underside to exactly NINE short bent legs, arranged as THREE separated groups with exactly THREE independently countable legs in EACH group, all emerging from the lower edge. The two tails remain on the side without shelves, but extend horizontally rather than arching upward. Keep a single short vertical bark-plate body, TWO eyes, zero wings, three semicircular shelves on one side only with each lower shelf wider, and the front three-quarter view showing them. Keep #B69069 / #8D8A95 / #E9D5B6 palette roles and soft shelf-fungus/bark material. Clear dark contour and restrained three-step cel shading per material, simplified material texture. No extra shelves, mirrored wings, human torso, bony legs, sharp claws, text, background scenery or shadow outside silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha, full body centered square.
expanded_prompts.sm-decay-019-default-attempt003-prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Change ONLY the rendering of this exact creature to the established clean hand-drawn 2D game style: strong crisp dark contour and restrained THREE-step cel shading per material, with distinct flat base/shadow/highlight shapes. Reduce speckled continuous highlights on bark and legs, and simplify concentric shelf coloration to restrained broad material bands, without creating extra shelves. Preserve exactly the current anatomy, silhouette and pose: NINE short bent legs in THREE separated groups of THREE, TWO eyes, TWO horizontal tails on the side without shelves, THREE one-sided semicircular shelves progressively wider toward the bottom, one short vertical bark-plate body, wings0. Preserve bark and soft shelf-fungus material cues and #B69069/#8D8A95/#E9D5B6 palette roles. No geometry redesign or deleted feet. Genuine transparent background, no halo or cast shadow, full body centered square, no text.
expanded_prompts.sm-decay-019-pixel-attempt001-prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one authentic pixel-art creature sprite, a paired rendition of the approved original illustration
Input image 1: the approved default illustration for sm-decay-019; it is the identity reference and must remain the same creature.
Primary request: Redraw this exact creature as carefully constructed pixel art. Change only the rendering medium. Do not invent a replacement design and do not merely downsample or apply a pixelation filter to the input.
Management only, do not render text: sm-decay-019 / ヒラダネム / 腐体 (decay)
Locked body and anatomy: 体幹1節の縦に短い樹皮板形。脚9本、目2個、翼0枚、尾2本。片側に半円の棚が3段張り出す
Locked material cues: 枯木表面の柔らかな棚状菌。乾いた樹皮の細片を受け、雨で少しずつ土へ流す
Locked palette roles, primary/secondary/accent: #B69069; #8D8A95; #E9D5B6
All three identifiers must remain recognizable: 三段の棚は下段ほど幅広い; 九本脚は下辺から三本ずつのまとまりで出る; 二本尾は棚のない側へ水平に伸びる
Locked pose: 棚の張り出しを斜め前から見せ、脚を短く曲げる
Locked temperament/expression: 安定志向。斜面でも棚を水平に保つ. Preserve eyeless or faceless designs without adding eyes or a face; for those designs use posture to convey temperament.
Rendering: an intentional 128 by 128 logical pixel grid, readable pixel clusters, controlled staircase contours, consistent 1–2 logical pixel outline, limited palette no more than 32 visible colors, hard-edged opaque pixels and transparent background pixels only. Preserve exact counts of eyes, limbs, wings, tails and other declared structures. Simplify surface texture, never delete identity features or invent anatomy.
Composition: match the reference's facing, pose, relative color placement and body proportions. Full body, centered, longest creature extent about 96–112 logical pixels, at least 8 logical pixels of transparent padding on every side. No cropped body parts.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no backdrop, no shadow, no glow spilling out of the silhouette. Do not render any habitat, rock, water surface or action scenery mentioned in the brief; depict only the creature and its posture.
Individual forbidden changes: 棚を翼として左右対称にしない; 樹皮板を人型の胴にしない; 脚を骨や鋭い爪に変えない
Avoid: antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients, semitransparent pixels, inconsistent pixel sizes, painterly miniatures, pixelation overlays, extra characters, text, letters, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, redesign.
expanded_prompts.sm-decay-019-pixel-attempt002-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit only the exterior of this exact pixel sprite: remove the entire diffuse brown halo surrounding the body, shelves, tails, and legs and make all exterior pixels truly transparent. Preserve the creature silhouette and all internal pixels/design: nine short bent legs in three groups of three, two eyes, two horizontal tails, three one-sided shelves wider below, bark palette and pose. Keep a crisp one-to-two logical pixel dark contour directly on the silhouette, no extra shadow or glow. Authentic 128x128 logical pixel grid, no antialiasing, at most32 visible colors, opaque body and transparent outside only. Do not blur, change anatomy, add parts or text. Full body square with transparent padding.
Also restore exactly TWO clearly distinguishable eyes in their existing positions below the shelves: make each a separate dark-outlined small eye with a visible light iris/highlight, without adding a face or changing body geometry.

processing_summary.default: alpha below8 cleared; isolated source alpha components under128 pixels cleared; alpha bbox cropped; proportional LANCZOS longest864; alpha below8 cleared; centered transparent1024; no shape redraw
processing_summary.pixel: independently generated pixel reference; alpha128 threshold; source isolated components under128 cleared; crop bbox; proportional nearest longest108; MEDIANCUT32 no dithering; binary alpha retained; centered128; no shape redraw

qa.basis: 通常原寸、pixel原寸と8倍nearest表示、通常/pixel比較を独立レビュー。短い樹皮板、九脚三群三本、二眼、片側三棚で下ほど広い、反対側水平二尾。脚群・尾方向・通常塗り・pixelハローと眼明瞭化を生成編集で修正。pixel第二眼は右端棚下に小さいが独立した暗い眼として確認。 PNG規格・永続保存読戻し検証済み。
review_notes: 不採用を含む全生成原本を保全。
透明画素に複数のRGB値が残るが、表示には影響せず、仕様の可視色数32以下を満たす。
